notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where you were suddenly teleported to the roof or the customer's head. Customer's or anyone can no longer take you up.
The problem of seating 2 customers at a table was eliminated.
Fixed an error that occurred when BTC Miner was sold.
Fixed issue where some computers or console desks became unusable. Customers did not sit at some tables, this problem has disappeared. Fixed issue where orders still appear on table when customers leave table.
Fixed issue where some objects could not taken.

Hotfix v.1
Comments tab opened fps drop issue was fixed.
Fixed the problem of objects not sticking to the wall on the upper floor. (BTC miner, tv, poster)
Fixed an error that prevented ad block from being purchased again.
You can now change the background color.
Fixed issue with walls, floor and ceiling not being registered.
Fixed an excessive monetization bug when changing internet cafe fees.
Fixed bug where some Headphones lost.
